Introduction

1VERSE (pronounced Universe), formerly known as SB BOYZ, is a 5-member boy group under Singing Beetle Entertainment. The group currently consists of: Kenny, Hyuk, Nathan, Seok, and Aito. They debuted on July 18, 2025, with the single album "The 1st Verse".
